The zero-coordinate strata separate smooth two-zero points from singular three-zero lines. The quadratic cone Q(u)=∑s_i u_i² on W={∑u_i=0} has polar radical the radial line ks, hence rank four on projectivization. The boundary point count is 20(q−2)+15=20q−25. Independent full projective F3/F5 singular censuses corroborate 46 and 85, but the written algebraic-closure argument proves completeness.
